title: Screenshots through Caduceus into satty (swappy fallback), with copy/save toasts.
summary: Keys capture an area, full screen, or window through the Caduceus face door into satty (swappy where absent); copy and save toast a thumbnail.
description: Screenshot keys send capture requests through the Caduceus face door into satty (swappy where absent). Ctrl+C copies and Ctrl+S saves; either action toasts with a thumbnail and closes, while Esc closes silently.
